notes: Deterministic offline finance fixtures. Every input is a synthetic number written into the task; no market data, no jdds.db content, no provider call. Each answer is graded by an INDEPENDENT recomputation of the same metric.

tasks.name: Net margin
tasks.description: Compute the net margin from revenue and net income; graded by an independent recomputation.

input.prompt: Revenue is 1000 and net income is 120. What is the net margin?

tasks.name: Operating margin
tasks.description: Compute the operating margin from revenue and operating income.

input.prompt: Revenue is 800 and operating income is 160. What is the operating margin?

tasks.name: EV/EBITDA
tasks.description: Compute enterprise value over EBITDA from the two given numbers.

input.prompt: Enterprise value is 1000 and EBITDA is 250. What is EV/EBITDA?

tasks.name: Earnings per share
tasks.description: Compute EPS from net income and the share count.

input.prompt: Net income is 500 and there are 100 shares outstanding. What is EPS?

tasks.name: Portfolio weight
tasks.description: Compute one position's share of a portfolio from its value and the total.

input.prompt: One position is worth 250 and the whole portfolio is worth 1000. What is the position weight?

agent_script.content: The position weight is 0.25 (250 / 1000, i.e. a quarter of the portfolio).
